text:
Maya: Kickoff for a short Quickstart RefKit series + one companion benchmark post. Goal: 1) 6-step tutorial repo + 3min screencast, 2) short benchmark story for blog, 3) 30m live walkthrough to seed community. Timeline: two weeks.
Sam: Nice. Audience = devs prototyping inference + OSS contributors. Keep the tutorial repo minimal: README, 3 runnable examples (chat, summarize, embed).
Ellen: Lead capture: simple email + role + company size. Map to HubSpot listId=47100, utm_campaign=refkit_quickstart, hidden lead_source=refkit_qs_2026. Automations: attendees -> nurture drip; enterprise -> AE-alert.
Diego: Benchmark narrative idea: baseline (stock run) vs "RefKit tuned" (small batching, KV prefix caching, int8) showing 2x-4x cost reduction. Key metrics: p95 latency, cost/1k tokens, seq/sec. We'll include a tiny chart and CSV for reproducibility.
Maya: Assignments: Sam -> repo + short screencast; Diego -> benchmark runs + CSV; Ellen -> HubSpot + routing; I'll write the blog draft and run the event.
Sam: Repo structure draft: /examples/{chat,sum,embed}, /bench, /docs/quickstart.md, /assets/screencast.mp4. Add a tiny Dockerfile for one-click run.
Diego: Bench commands (add to README):
```bash
# baseline
python examples/bench.py --model small --batch 1 --quant none --iters 150
# tuned
python examples/bench.py --model small --batch 6 --quant int8 --kv_cache true --iters 150
```
I'll summarise p95 and $/1k tokens in the blog.
Ellen: HubSpot field mapping: email, name, role, company_size(dropdown: indie/startup/growth/enterprise), hidden fields above. Automation: add tag "refkit_quickstart"; if company_size==enterprise -> assign to AE queue.
Maya: Blog headline options: "Quickstart RefKit: Build a refapp in 10 minutes and cut inference cost" or "RefKit Quickstart + Benchmark: 2x+ lower cost with tiny infra changes". Prefer concise.
Sam: Screencast plan: 3m showing clone, install, run chat example; highlight the one-liner to switch on caching and quant. Add captions and code snippets in the repo.
Ellen: Registration URL will be https://redwood.link/refkit-quickstart (temp). I'll update once HS publishes. Also set UTM for syndication: utm_source=community, utm_medium=social.
Diego: Suggest we publish bench CSV and a short Jupyter notebook for reproducibility. That helps community trust.
Maya: Event plan: 30m slot: 10m demo, 8m bench story, 12m Q&A. Record and clip 2-3 short highlights for Twitter/LinkedIn.
Sam: I'll add a small CONTRIBUTING.md so community folks can PR new examples.
marketing-bot: Reminder scheduled: "RefKit Quickstart launch" in 2 weeks  reminders: 7d, 1d, 1h before.
Maya: Final checklist: repo & screencast (Sam), bench CSV + notebook (Diego), HubSpot form + URL (Ellen), blog draft + event logistics (Maya). Ping here when done. :sparkles:
